- **Pick:** Links2Care runs the Halton Hills EarlyON centres. 
Its programs and activities for children from birth to their 6th birthday and their parents or caregivers are free.
 
They run weekdays, weekends and evenings, and include in-person drop-in sessions.
 That covers a toddler. 
The Acton location is at the Halton Hills Public Library, 17 River Street.

- **Day and time:** I left `when` out. Their page points to a "Current Schedule" further down, and what I could read didn't include a specific day or time.
- **Left out, not free:** Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has a preschool drop-in for under 4s. 
It costs $15 per parent for up to 4 children and runs Tuesdays and Thursdays 9:30 am to 12:00 pm.
 The town's Parent & Tot skate costs a few dollars. I didn't count either as free.
- **Left out, no operator page:** Halton Region Public Health's "Kids & Me" free weekly drop-in groups showed up only on a directory listing. I didn't read the operator's own page, so I didn't include it.
